fills.name: Stew Ponds
fills.tieReason: Frame s_01108 shows the STEW PONDS tooltip (Lowland Technology, 750 gold, 1m 0s, Unique to Scots). Its text reads: 'Increases Fishpond capacity by 1 and increases gather rates of workers near Fishponds from 10% to 20%. Instantly spawns a free Kirkman.' Both numbers are legible, so the dispute is only about which one is the headline effect. The first effect listed is capacity +1, and the project's existing record (data/upcoming-civs/CHECKLIST.md, from the BeastyQT fill) already uses effectValue=1 for Stew Ponds. The 10%->20% gather bonus is a secondary effect and belongs in effectText. Note: the 750 gold cost is lower than the base cost; the jeando data gives 1500 gold.
